“If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

translations.web: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!
translations.bsb: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!
translations.kjv: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
translations.asv: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: How much more the wicked and the sinner!
